recentItems.title: Teen pleads guilty in deadly Centereach crash that killed 73-year-old woman
recentItems.description:
An 18-year-old has pleaded guilty to multiple charges, including aggravated vehicular homicide, in a deadly crash in Centereach, New York. Prosecutors say that when Matthew Papile was 16, he stole an SUV, drove while high at a high rate of speed, and crashed into another vehicle, killing 73-year-old Marion Napolitano and seriously injuring her son. He faces up to 18 years in prison and is expected to be sentenced next month.

recentItems.title: Flooded half marathon sparks backlash, organizer placed on probation
recentItems.description:

Bergen County says organizers were advised to use an alternate route that avoided flood-prone areas in Saddle River County Park. The race organizer has been placed on probation, while officials are also reviewing the actions of participants who entered restricted areas.

recentItems.description:

A Seastreak ferry captain first alerted authorities after noticing the boat unguided and out of place.

recentItems.title: NYC sues over new immigration rule that could impact Green Card applications
recentItems.description:
A new public charge rule is set to take effect Friday, allowing federal officials to consider the use of certain public benefits when issuing green cards or visas. New York City is among several major cities taking legal action, arguing the policy disregards settled law and federal guidance. Supporters and critics are clashing over what the rule could mean for immigrant families.
